memories.text: Met as a traveler, with no inherited favors assumed.
Promised to organize archive records before the succession meeting.
Kept the promise to organize the archive records.
Took in Wren, a nine-year-old orphan of the Village, as your ward.

cartographer.label: Visiting cartographer's briefing
cartographer.missedText: You hear that a cartographer gave a route-reading briefing in Village earlier. The visiting group has already departed.

inheritance.label: The elder's archive succession
inheritance.missedText: You hear that the elder entrusted his old watchpost archive to another traveler in Village. The succession meeting has ended.

log.text: A new chronicle begins. Local invitations have game-time deadlines; rumors can reach you later.
Archive duty accepted. Complete the five-minute task through the normal action controls; succession closes at its announced deadline.
Your work earns a concrete succession claim. The elder values this kept promise independently of combat prowess.
The elder brings a quiet nine-year-old named Wren to your door. I find a second bowl; the household has grown by one.
